meta.title: Reportaje
meta.goal: Ya reportas con It is said that… y subject + is said to + infinitivo.

cards.title: Reportaje: qué expresa
cards.lede: Ya reportas con It is said that… y subject + is said to + infinitivo.

rows.value: It is reported that the company is expanding. · Estructura impersonal
The CEO is expected to resign tomorrow. · Enfoque en el sujeto
He is believed to have left the country. · to have + participio
say, believe, think, report, claim, consider, expect, rumor

tip.label: Objetivo:
tip.body: reconocer el patrón y usarlo en frases propias.

cards.title: La estructura que debes recordar
cards.lede: Observa la estructura completa antes de producir tus propios ejemplos.

rows.value: It + is/was + participio + that + oración · It is thought that the economy will recover.
Sujeto + is/are + participio + to + infinitivo base · The painting is said to be authentic.
Sujeto + is/are + participio + to have + V3 · The suspect is reported to have escaped.
It is not expected that prices will fall. / He is not thought to be involved.

cards.title: Ejemplos naturales
cards.lede: Lee cada ejemplo en situaciones reales del día a día.

rows.value: It is estimated that over ten thousand people attended the demonstration in Berlin.
The ancient fortress is believed to have been constructed during the 14th century.
The tech giant is rumored to be developing a revolutionary artificial intelligence chip.
The government minister is expected to deliver a public address later this evening.

cards.title: Cómo cambia el significado
cards.lede: Compara estas opciones para saber cuándo elegir cada una.

columns.label: Voz Activa (Sujeto activo impreciso)
columns.rule: Menciona a la gente o fuentes generales como sujeto de la oración.
examples: People say that he earns millions.
Journalists report that the fire started at midnight.

columns.label: Pasiva Reportada (Periodística / Formal)
columns.rule: Elimina el sujeto difuso y le da tono objetivo y periodístico al enunciado.
examples: He is said to earn millions.
The fire is reported to have started at midnight.

cards.title: Evita este calco
cards.lede: Compara la versión incorrecta con la forma natural en inglés.

lines.text: People is said that the castle is haunted.
It is said that the castle is haunted. / The castle is said to be haunted.
lines.note: no mezcles la pasiva reportada con 'People'; usa la forma impersonal 'It is said that' o el sujeto 'The castle is said to'

cards.title: Guía rápida de uso
cards.lede: Comprueba las reglas clave para este patrón.

rows.key: 'It is said that...' no cambia el verbo
rows.value: La oración tras 'that' mantiene su estructura y tiempo normal.
Usa 'to be' para estados presentes y 'to have been' para eventos pasados.
Es la estructura preferida en noticias, investigación y redacción académica.
Asegúrate de cambiar 'is' por 'are' si el sujeto es plural (They are said to be...).

tip.label: Práctica:
tip.body: escribe una frase personal con el patrón.

quiz.q: The missing painting ___ to have been destroyed during the war.
quiz.explain: Estructura pasiva de reporte con sujeto de enfoque: 'Sujeto + is believed + to have + V3'.

quiz.q: ___ is reported that negotiators have reached a preliminary peace agreement.
quiz.explain: La estructura impersonal de reporte comienza con el pronombre neutro 'It' ('It is reported that...').

quiz.q: The company's CEO is expected ___ his resignation later today.
quiz.explain: Tras 'is expected' se requiere el infinitivo con 'to' ('to announce').
